visual_history.assessment:
- Floating/Disconnected Pieces: All components (seat, backrest, arms, ottoman) are completely separated by large gaps.
- Wrong Proportions: The parts are half the size intended due to a math error in scaling (dividing target dimensions by 2 when applying scale to a unit cube).
- Misalignment: Because of the sizing error, the coordinates calculated for placement do not align with the actual geometry.
The model accurately includes all requested components—boxy frame, armrests, seat, reclined backrest, and separate ottoman—with appropriate softness to represent upholstery.
